candidates.change_summary: Change the block assignment to record the current block instead of next block (set guesses[msg.sender].block = block.number).
Remove the block assignment entirely so the stored block remains zero (no guesses[msg.sender].block set).
Set the stored block to block.number + 2 instead of block.number + 1 (delays the recorded block by one more).
Set the stored block to a constant nonzero value (1) rather than using block.number + 1.
Assign the guess hash after setting the block number (swap the two assignment statements' order).
Replace the blockhash lookup to use the current block number (block.number) instead of the locked block, changing answer and thus settlement outcome.
Replace the blockhash lookup with a constant nonzero value, making success depend only on whether the stored guess equals that constant.
Replace the assignment that clears the stored block to occur after the transfer check, so the guess remains until after potential payout (changing state visible after settle).
Replace the require that enforces block progression with a stricter equal-or-greater check, allowing settle in the same block as the locked block when equal (changing when state is cleared).
Replace the require that the guess exists with a check that silently returns when no guess is present, changing observable settled state (no revert on missing guess).
